summary: A vulnerability was detected in Moonshot AI Kimi Code up to 2.0.2. This vulnerability affects...
description: A vulnerability was detected in Moonshot AI Kimi Code up to 2.0.2. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file .kimi-code/local.toml of the component WorkspaceDirsService. summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Moonshot AI Kimi Code up to 2.5.2. This affects the...
description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Moonshot AI Kimi Code up to 2.5.2. This affects the function isOriginAllowed of the file apps/kimi-code/dist-web/assets/index-HU0LCM-X.js of the component Web UI. Such manipulation of the argument kimi_origin leads to open redirect. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

summary: A flaw was found in the Konflux UI proxy. Hostname values defined in the KonfluxUI custom...
description: A flaw was found in the Konflux UI proxy. Hostname values defined in the KonfluxUI custom resource are inserted directly into proxy configuration files without adequate validation or sanitization. An authenticated user with permissions to modify the custom resource can inject malicious configuration directives to bypass authentication and authorization controls, potentially exposing internal backend services. In addition, providing malformed input can cause the configuration generator to fail, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) by preventing the proxy from starting.

summary: An internal security review identified a development regression from ThinkSystem v4 XClarity...
description: An internal security review identified a development regression from ThinkSystem v4 XClarity Controller 3 (XCC3) versions (2.51) IHX432Y to (2.56) IHX436K which re-introduces the default OpenBMC root password upon performing an XCC Reset to Default operation.  An attacker can gain access to enabled administrative interfaces of XCC using the default OpenBMC credential re-introduced after Reset to Default. Additionally, this provides access to the underlying XCC Operating System which is not normally accessible. Only these versions are affected and are no longer available for download. Process enhancements have also been made to prevent and identify potential future regression.
